findings.issue: Sequential cleanup could skip stop-event, join, signal restoration or final sample after earlier cleanup exception and could replace original body exception.
findings.resolution: Independently attempt all owned terminal actions, persist primary and cleanup error evidence, rethrow original body exception by identity; reject cleanup-only errors.

findings.issue: Outer zero_op_qualification_complete could remain true after final protected-source failure.
findings.resolution: Set outer qualification false on every non-PASS terminal result; preserve separately copied native PASS unchanged.
